details.text: Paul strikes right back! The crowd is hushed as the big-hitting Abhishek falls in the first over. This is on a good length around middle and leg, Abhishek looks to whip it over midwicket again but it hits high on the bat and chips to the in-ring fielder at midwicket. Shamar Joseph grabs it above his head and that's a great outcome for West Indies!
